source: An invented audit of the made-up example-org/example-app, for tests only.
method: One entry per build unit in the units table. days = the plan's estimate; code = the share built (low and high bound it); live = yes, partly or no.

U01.title: Design kit
U01.why: Every kit part is on main and in use

U02.title: App frame
U02.why: Sidebar and header on main; the narrow layout is not

U03.title: Sign-in and households
U03.why: Sign-in is live; household roles are coded but switched off

U04.title: Test suite and checks
U04.why: Checks run on every change; browser tests are not written

U05.title: Hosting and backups
U05.why: Practice copy live; backups coded but not scheduled

U06.title: Draw beds
U06.why: Beds draw to scale; resizing is half done

U07.title: Rows and moves
U07.why: Rows exist in the model only

U09.title: Garden tasks
U09.why: Tasks work; repeat rules do not

U10.title: Reminders
U10.why: Only the reminder settings page exists
